title: refactor: shared-infra dedup
desiredOutcome: The four duplication classes are single definitions before any big file is split: one path-importlib loader (_loader.py, replacing 12 scripts-side copies), one atomic JSON writer (mkstemp semantics in _manifest_io), one front-matter parser (_help.front_matter), one token/cost formatter (_fmt.py). New modules are then born on final infra, never migrated twice.

tasks.title: _loader.py: one path-importlib loader, one caching policy
tasks.description: New flat module: load(path, modname=None, cache=True) keyed by realpath, load_script(basename) for siblings, load_hooks_config() for ../hooks/_config.py. No sys.modules registration. Replaces the 12 scripts-side importlib copies (5 different caching strategies today). The 2 hooks-side copies stay: hooks must not depend on scripts/ at module level, and the docstring records why. Selftest: same-object caching, cache=False isolation, missing file raises, no sys.modules pollution.

outcome.technical: _loader.py: load(path, modname=None, cache=True) via spec_from_file_location, one process-wide cache keyed by realpath, no sys.modules registration, failures propagate and are never cached; load_script() and load_hooks_config() cover the two common shapes. Docstring records the 5 prior caching policies consolidated and why hooks/ keeps its own copies. 11 selftest cases; the cache policy mutation-proven red (3 cases).
outcome.descriptive: scripts/ has one path-importlib loader with one caching policy - the seed that replaces 14 ad-hoc copies.

verifiedBy: _loader selftest 11 cases: identity, isolation, realpath dedup, no sys.modules pollution, error propagation without cache poisoning

tasks.title: Migrate loader call sites: panel-server + _help
tasks.description: panel-server (_load/_cores, _lockmod, _journalmod, _viewer ledger load) and _help (x3) call _loader instead of hand-rolled spec_from_file_location. Pure mechanical migration; behavior pinned by the existing selftests of both files.

outcome.technical: Every hand-rolled spec_from_file_location triplet in panel-server.py (5 sites: _load/_cores, _lockmod, _journalmod, _viewer's ledger load) and _help.py (3 sites: _config_mod, _journal_mod, the s8 panel load) now delegates to _loader, soft-fail semantics preserved at each call site; panel's _load kept as a one-line wrapper so its other internal callers ride the shared loader. 19 insertions / 38 deletions; import importlib.util gone from both files.
outcome.descriptive: panel-server and _help load siblings through the one shared loader instead of eight private copies, with zero behavior change.

tasks.title: Migrate loader call sites: the seven remaining scripts
tasks.description: Same mechanical migration for audit-status (x3), audit-usage (x2), render-report (x3), audit-doctor, gen-demo-manifest (x3), gen-demo-usage (x2), migrate-manifest. Each file’s own selftest pins behavior.

outcome.technical: All 15 hand-rolled spec_from_file_location sites across audit-status, audit-usage, render-report, audit-doctor, gen-demo-manifest, gen-demo-usage and migrate-manifest now call _loader; fresh-reload sites migrated with cache=False to preserve exact semantics, single-shot sites use the default cache; every soft-fail wrapper kept at its call site. import importlib.util gone from all seven. grep confirms zero remaining hand-rolled sites.
outcome.descriptive: The last seven scripts with private importlib boilerplate now go through the single shared loader, behavior unchanged.

tasks.title: One atomic JSON writer: mkstemp semantics into _manifest_io
tasks.description: Public read_json/atomic_write_json in _manifest_io with the better semantics from panel-server:448 (unique mkstemp temp in target dir, finally-cleanup, makedirs, per-caller ensure_ascii). save_sharded and the panel delegate to it; the collision-prone path+".tmp" writer dies. Byte output unchanged per caller: CI’s gen-demo-usage diff and the docs/index.html cmp guard this. New mutation-proven cases: temp cleaned on write failure, concurrent-suffix uniqueness, trailing newline.

add: atomic-write failure cleanup + uniqueness + byte-stability cases

outcome.technical: _manifest_io.atomic_write_json/read_json now carry the mkstemp semantics from the panel (unique temp in target dir, makedirs, trailing newline, os.replace, finally-cleanup); the old private names are byte-preserving aliases so save_sharded's output is unchanged, and the panel's writers are one-line delegations keeping ensure_ascii=False. 18 -> 29 selftest cases; failure-cleanup and mkstemp-spy cases mutation-proven red against the old naive writer.
outcome.descriptive: One atomic JSON writer backs both the shard files and the panel, with collision-free temps and no byte drift.

tasks.title: One front-matter parser: _help.front_matter
tasks.description: Promote a public _help.front_matter(text) merging the two implementations (panel-server:467 line-walk vs _help:509 regex): CRLF, quoted/escaped scalars, indented continuation, missing closing fence, >4KB front matter. The divergent edge cases become selftest cases; panel discovery delegates.

add: front-matter edge cases where the two old parsers disagreed

outcome.technical: _help.front_matter(text) is the single parser: full-block regex, CRLF-tolerant, indented continuations skipped, unquote_scalar for scalars, no length cap; _frontmatter(path) is a read+delegate wrapper and the panel's _front_matter delegates. _fm_of keeps its 4096-byte scan cap but re-reads whole when the closing fence is beyond it. _help 59 -> 65 cases; the continuation-skip mutation-proven red.
outcome.descriptive: The panel's scanner and the help system read front matter through one parser, and the edge cases they used to disagree on are decided and locked.
